rationale: Reuses the established find_issues(status_filter=<local set>) mechanism without widening the shared _TERMINAL_STATUSES constant, which is load-bearing for dependency-graph resolution (BUG-2897) and deliberately treats deferred as non-terminal elsewhere.
rule: Option B — scan-local three-value status set (done, cancelled, deferred) for type_mismatch filtering
alternatives_rejected: Option A — reuse issue_progress._TERMINAL_STATUSES (done, cancelled) directly; under-filters relative to this issue's Expected Behavior since deferred is excluded from that shared constant by design.
